model: Native PyTorch additive spline GAM hedonic head plus multi-head attention over training-profile-only functional micro-market similarity edges and a GRU over prior-quarter asking/guidance and declared/guidance summaries. Unseen markets map to a shared OOV node. Training combines interval-censored likelihood with generated exact-price anchors; inference uses a bounded truncated-lognormal posterior mean.

features: interactive graph model estimates and intervals

data_status: ALL model training labels, paired signals, and validation values in this run are generated synthetic fixtures; not observed Bengaluru transactions.
proposal_coverage_gaps: No listing portal originals, observed registered deeds, RERA project table, property coordinates, POI data, IT park data, or dated metro milestones are present in the two canonical CSVs.
The graph therefore uses functional similarity edges between synthetic micro-market nodes, not spatial adjacency or a full project/city/amenity graph.
The five-seed and holdout scores measure recovery of generated latent prices only; they do not establish real-market accuracy or conformal coverage under temporal shift.

LightGBM, MugRep, ReGram, ST-RAP, SHAP, and the proposal's formal Diebold-Mariano comparison are not implemented; available comparisons include anchor-only Ridge and histogram-gradient-boosting proxies, signal baselines, ablations, and paired Wilcoxon diagnostics.
